verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sandboxes as isolated test environments that do not affect the live integration. Test transactions there use test values and test cards and move no funds, and team members can be invited to sandboxes without access to live-mode data. Agent-specific support is explicit: `stripe sandbox create` provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys for coding agents, MCP access is configured separately for sandbox and live mode, and the Workbench Shell is read-only in live mode while writes go to a sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation in agent workflows.
